full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media painting shows a grotesque, skull-like figure from the shoulders up against a stained cream ground. The head tilts slightly to the right, crowned by a jagged block of saturated yellow that rises off the top edge. Two large uneven eyes bulge from a dark blue-black and orange mask of paint; one catches a bright milky reflection while the other sinks into a murkier shadow. The mouth is a wide yellow bar packed with small pale teeth, creating an uneasy grin. Below, a narrow neck leads to the recognizable shape of a dark formal jacket, pale collar, and orange-red tie. Those orderly clothing cues clash with the unruly face. Hot pink, rust orange, teal, ocher, yellow, and black strokes overlap and partly obscure the features. Thin liquid drips run from the eye area and across the mouth, while broad smeared patches and dry scraping leave irregular edges. Splashes spread horizontally into the pale background, especially beside the cheeks, and more drips descend toward the bottom. The surface appears layered with paint, ink, and possibly torn or overprinted marks, so no area is perfectly smooth. Despite the disorder, dark contours keep both eyes, nose, teeth, and jacket readable. The composition is nearly frontal and centralized, with the crown acting as a bright peak and the suit as a dark base. Lighting is suggested by color contrast and painted highlights rather than a natural light source. The mood is mischievous, abrasive, and slightly threatening, like a street-art caricature whose ceremonial costume cannot tame its wild material energy.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介绘画把一位骷髅般怪诞人物从肩部以上放在沾污的奶油色底面前。头略向右偏，顶着一块饱和黄色的锯齿王冠，冠尖伸出上边缘。两只大小不齐的大眼从蓝黑与橙色颜料构成的面具中凸出；一只承接明亮乳白反光，另一只陷入较浑浊的阴影。嘴是一道宽阔黄色横条，塞满细小浅色牙齿，形成令人不安的笑。下方狭窄脖颈连着可辨的深色正式外套、浅色衣领和橙红领带。这些有序的衣服提示与失控面孔相冲突。艳粉、锈橙、青绿、赭黄、亮黄与黑色笔触重叠，并局部遮盖五官。细流体颜料从眼部向下滴落并划过嘴，宽阔涂抹和干涩刮擦留下不规则边缘。泼色横向扩散到浅色背景，尤其在两颊旁，更多流痕向底部延伸。表面似由颜料、墨与可能的撕贴或套印痕层叠构成，没有一处全然平滑。尽管纷乱，深色轮廓仍使双眼、鼻、牙与外套可读。构图近乎正面且居中，以王冠为明亮顶点，以西装为深色基座。照明由色彩反差和绘制高光暗示，而非自然光源。气氛顽皮、粗粝且略具威胁，像一幅街头艺术讽像，仪式服装无法驯服其狂野的材料能量。
style_prompt_en: Expressive mixed-media painting collides readable figurative structure with spontaneous street-art marks. Opaque black and teal masses anchor bursts of hot pink, rust orange, ocher, and acidic yellow on an off-white stained support. Paint is visibly handled: wet drips fall vertically, broad smears spread sideways, and dry scraping breaks edges into granular fragments. Rough collaged or overprinted layers can interrupt contours, but a few dark lines preserve the focal form beneath the noise. Color rather than realistic lighting supplies the brightest accents, with milky highlights emerging from saturated shadow. A nearly frontal central mass can be balanced by splashes that escape into open margins. The image should feel unruly and tactile, yet designed around a clear visual peak and base, allowing dark humor and unease to coexist.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性混合媒介绘画让可读的具象结构与自发街头艺术痕迹相撞。不透明黑色和青绿色体块在灰白沾污底面上压住艳粉、锈橙、赭黄与酸性亮黄的爆发。颜料的手工操作清晰可见：湿滴向下流，宽涂抹横向扩展，干刮擦把边缘破成颗粒碎片。粗糙拼贴或套印层可以打断轮廓，但少量深色线仍保存杂讯下的焦点形体。色彩而非写实照明提供最亮重音，乳白高光从饱和暗面中出现。近乎正面的中央体量由逃入开放边距的泼色平衡。图像应失控而可触，却仍围绕清楚的视觉顶点与基座组织，使黑色幽默和不安并存。
theme_en: A crowned grotesque face in a suit erupts from layered paint
theme_zh: 一张戴王冠、穿西装的怪诞面孔从层叠颜料中涌现
name: Anthony Lister
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
